facts: Parties: Orwell Capital LLP (Company) and Corrib Industries Securities (Underwriter).
Clause 3: the Company shall pay the Underwriters a commission of 7.0% of the gross proceeds of the Offering (12,500,000 shares at $14.00 per share), being $10,412,500.
Clause 7(b): the comfort letter cut-off date shall be no earlier than 3 business days before the pricing date. The pricing date is 26 May 2026.

Clause 9: the Underwriters may offer the Shares to investors in the United States, Canada and the European Economic Area. No selling restrictions or exemption conditions are specified for any jurisdiction.
Issuer: Orwell Capital LLP. The date of this Prospectus is 26 May 2026.
Use of Proceeds: net proceeds of $150,000,000 will be applied as follows: repayment of the revolving facility $68,000,000; capital expenditure $45,000,000; general corporate purposes $45,000,000.
Paragraph 6: our procedures covered the period up to 14 May 2026 (the cut-off date).
